name: Artificial island / sea island
description: Constructed landmass or caisson-supported island providing a land-like drilling and production site in shallow water. Primary source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_island

specifications.basis: Wikipedia Artificial Island: technological advancements make it feasible to build artificial islands in waters as deep as 75 m; wave size and structural integrity determine maximum depth
Wikipedia Offshore concrete structure, C G DORIS type and table row 1
specifications.value: C G Doris platform shaped like a marine sea island, surrounded by perforated breakwater wall (Jarlan patent); 71 m North Sea, 1973
Under UNCLOS not harbour works (Art 11); no own territorial sea/EEZ; only coastal state may authorise within 200 nm (Art 56, 60); on high seas any state may construct (Art 87)

applications: Constructed landmass or caisson-supported island providing a land-like drilling and production site in shallow water.
